svg.title: Constant temperature / lighting bias
svg.desc: Two identical beakers with thermometers. An arrow shows sunlight falling on one, which reads 24 degrees Celsius; the other, in the shade, reads the true 20 degrees Celsius. Source: environmental. Explanation: conditions consistently differ from intended controls. Fix: control or correct the environmental condition before data collection.
svg.text: Conditions consistently differ from intended controls.
Control or correct the environmental condition
